_comment: Security headers (CSP + clickjacking + nosniff). The CSP script-src hash MUST be regenerated whenever the inline theme script in index.html changes — run: node -e "console.log('sha256-'+require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update(require('fs').readFileSync('index.html','utf8').match(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/)[1]).digest('base64'))" and paste the new value here. The supabase.co host is pinned to this project (connect-src/img-src); if the Supabase project URL ever changes, update it here too.
